meta.title: Buyer updates tick size and time difference mid-auction
gaps: Selecting a specific existing live Knockout auction when the case provides no event title or project ID
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Selecting a specific existing live Knockout auction when the case provides no event title or project ID

steps.note: Open the closest existing live event for the buyer-side mid-auction update.

args.goal: On the current buyer screen, verify this is a live Knockout auction, edit the tick size and time difference fields, click Update, and stop only when the screen shows the new values applied in the round details and upcoming offers.

steps.note: No catalog domain step exposes Knockout auction round-edit fields, so perform and verify the requested update directly on the buyer screen.
Confirm the resulting screen has no server error, crash, NaN, undefined, null, or raw IDs after the update.
